518	// IMPORTANT: must be called with m.mu write-locked. It temporarily releases
519	// and re-acquires m.mu while waiting for the evicted supervisor to exit,
520	// so the caller must re-validate procs state after it returns.
521	func (m *Manager) evictIfNeeded() error {
522		type candidate struct {
523			name     string
524			ps       *procState
525			lastUsed time.Time
526		}
527		var candidates []candidate
528		running := 0
529	
530		for name, ps := range m.procs {
531			ps.mu.Lock()
532			state := ps.state
533			lu := ps.lastUsed
534			ps.mu.Unlock()
535	
536			if state != stateIdle {
537				running++
538			}
539			if state == stateLoaded && ps.inflight.Load() == 0 {
540				candidates = append(candidates, candidate{name: name, ps: ps, lastUsed: lu})

544		if running < m.cfg.MaxModels {
545			return nil
546		}
547		if len(candidates) == 0 {
548			return fmt.Errorf("at capacity (%d/%d models); all models have in-flight requests", running, m.cfg.MaxModels)

551		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool {
552			return candidates[i].lastUsed.Before(candidates[j].lastUsed)

602		ps := m.procs[modelName]
603		m.mu.RUnlock()
604	
605		// Ensure state is idle and the ready channel is closed on exit (for any
606		// reason). This unblocks callers waiting in LoadOrGet and lets Loaded()
607		// return false after the supervisor exits.
608		defer func() {
609			ps.wg.Done()
610			ps.mu.Lock()
611			ready := ps.ready
612			ps.ready = nil
613			// Only preserve stateUnloading; evictIfNeeded owns that transition.
614			if ps.state != stateUnloading {
615				ps.state = stateIdle
616			}
617			ps.mu.Unlock()
618			if ready != nil {
619				close(ready)
620			}
621		}()
622	
623		const (
624			maxRetries  = 5
625			retryWindow = 60 * time.Second
626			backoff     = 2 * time.Second
627		)
628	
629		var (
630			attempts    int
631			windowStart = time.Now()
632			firstLoad   = true
633		)
634	
635		for {
636			select {
637			case <-ctx.Done():
638				return
639			default:
640			}
641	
642			if time.Since(windowStart) > retryWindow {
643				attempts = 0
644				windowStart = time.Now()
645			}
646			if attempts >= maxRetries {
647				m.log.Error("max restart retries exceeded, giving up", "model", modelName)
648				return
649			}
650	
651			if attempts > 0 && ps.isWarmup {
652				// Before retrying a warmup model, create a fresh ready channel so
653				// new callers waiting in LoadOrGet see the correct loading state.
654				ps.mu.Lock()
655				ps.state = stateLoading
656				ps.loadErr = nil
657				ps.ready = make(chan struct{})
658				ps.mu.Unlock()
659	
660				m.log.Info("restarting model", "model", modelName, "attempt", attempts)
661				select {
662				case <-ctx.Done():
663					return
664				case <-time.After(backoff):
665				}
666			}
667	
668			attempts++
669	
670			ps.mu.Lock()
671			if !firstLoad {
672				ps.restarts++
673			}
674			ps.startedAt = time.Now()
675			params := ps.params
676			ps.mu.Unlock()
677	
678			cmd, parser, err := m.launch(ctx, modelName, params)
679			if err != nil {
680				m.log.Error("failed to launch llama-server", "model", modelName, "error", err)
681				if !ps.isWarmup {
682					m.failLoad(ps, modelName, err)
683					return
684				}
685				continue
686			}
687	
688			// Wait for llama-server to report its listening port via stdout.
689			var port int
690			select {
691			case port = <-parser.PortCh:
692			case <-ctx.Done():
693				cmd.Process.Kill()
694				cmd.Wait() //nolint:errcheck
695				return
696			case <-time.After(m.effectiveHealthTimeout()):
697				m.log.Error("timed out waiting for listening port", "model", modelName)
698				cmd.Process.Kill()
699				cmd.Wait() //nolint:errcheck
700				if !ps.isWarmup {
701					m.failLoad(ps, modelName, fmt.Errorf("timed out waiting for listening port"))
702					return
703				}
704				continue
705			}
706	
707			ps.mu.Lock()
708			ps.port = port
709			ps.proc = cmd
710			ps.mu.Unlock()
711	
712			loadStart := time.Now()
713			if err := waitHealthy(ctx, port, m.effectiveHealthTimeout()); err != nil {
714				m.log.Error("health check failed on start", "model", modelName, "error", err)
715				cmd.Process.Kill()
716				cmd.Wait() //nolint:errcheck
717				ps.mu.Lock()
718				ps.proc = nil
719				ps.mu.Unlock()
720				if !ps.isWarmup {
721					m.failLoad(ps, modelName, err)
722					return
723				}
724				continue
725			}
726	
727			loadDur := time.Since(loadStart)
728	
729			// Transition to healthy and signal all waiters by closing ready.
730			ps.mu.Lock()
731			ps.state = stateLoaded
732			if firstLoad {
733				ps.lastUsed = time.Now()
734			}
735			ready := ps.ready
736			ps.ready = nil
737			ps.mu.Unlock()
738	
739			if ready != nil {
740				close(ready)
741			}
742			firstLoad = false
743	
744			m.log.Info("model healthy", "model", modelName, "port", port, "load_duration", loadDur)
745			m.publishEvent(monitor.ServerEvent{
746				Time:       time.Now(),
747				Backend:    modelName,
748				Kind:       monitor.EventModelLoad,
749				DurationMs: float64(loadDur.Milliseconds()),
750				Message:    "loaded",
751			})
752	
753			exitCh := make(chan error, 1)
754			go func() { exitCh <- cmd.Wait() }()
755	
756			select {
757			case <-ctx.Done():
758				<-exitCh
759				return
760	
761			case exitErr := <-exitCh:
762				ps.mu.Lock()
763				ps.state = stateIdle
764				ps.proc = nil
765				ps.mu.Unlock()
766	
767				if ctx.Err() != nil {
768					return
769				}
770	
771				oomKilled := false
772				if exitErr != nil {
773					if ee, ok := errors.AsType[*exec.ExitError](exitErr); ok {
774						// OOM killer sends SIGKILL — detect via WaitStatus.
775						if ws, ok := ee.Sys().(syscall.WaitStatus); ok && ws.Signal() == syscall.SIGKILL {
776							oomKilled = true
777							m.log.Error("process killed by SIGKILL (likely OOM)", "model", modelName)
778						} else {
779							m.log.Warn("process exited unexpectedly", "model", modelName, "exit_code", ee.ExitCode())
780						}
781					} else {
782						m.log.Warn("process exited unexpectedly", "model", modelName, "error", exitErr)
783					}
784				}
785	
786				if !ps.isWarmup {
787					// On-demand model crashed; remove and stop.
788					m.mu.Lock()
789					delete(m.procs, modelName)
790					m.mu.Unlock()
791					return
792				}
793	
794				// OOM: back off longer to let the system recover before reloading.
795				if oomKilled {
796					oomDelay := 30 * time.Second
797					m.log.Warn("delaying restart after OOM kill", "model", modelName, "delay", oomDelay)
798					select {
799					case <-ctx.Done():
800						return
801					case <-time.After(oomDelay):
802					}
803				}
804			}
805			// Warmup model: fall through to retry loop.
806		}
807	}

836	// stdout/stderr to the event parser. The actual listening port is sent
837	// to parser.PortCh once llama-server prints its "listening on" line.
838	func (m *Manager) launch(ctx context.Context, modelName string, params config.ModelParams) (*exec.Cmd, *monitor.EventParser, error) {
839		cmd := m.cmdBuilder(ctx, modelName, params)

841		cmd.Cancel = func() error {
842			if cmd.Process == nil {
843				return nil
844			}
845			return cmd.Process.Signal(syscall.SIGTERM)
846		}
847		cmd.WaitDelay = 10 * time.Second
848	
849		parser := monitor.NewEventParser(m.log, modelName, m.eventCh)
850		cmd.Stdout = parser
851		cmd.Stderr = parser
852	
853		if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
854			return nil, nil, err
855		}
856		return cmd, parser, nil
857	}

901	// waitHealthy polls GET /health on the given port every second until it
902	// returns 200 OK, the context is cancelled, or the timeout elapses.
903	func waitHealthy(ctx context.Context, port int, timeout time.Duration) error {
904		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, timeout)
905		defer cancel()
906	
907		url := fmt.Sprintf("http://localhost:%d/health", port)
908		client := &http.Client{Timeout: 5 * time.Second}
909	
910		// Use a shorter poll interval when the timeout is short (test scenarios).
911		interval := time.Second
912		if timeout < time.Second {
913			interval = timeout / 5
914			if interval < 10*time.Millisecond {
915				interval = 10 * time.Millisecond
916			}
917		}
918	
919		ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
920		defer ticker.Stop()
921	
922		for {
923			select {
924			case <-ctx.Done():
925				return ctx.Err()
926			case <-ticker.C:
927				resp, err := client.Get(url) //nolint:noctx
928				if err == nil {
929					resp.Body.Close()
930					if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusOK {
931						return nil
932					}
933				}
934			}
935		}
936	}
